feature_semantics.first_chorus_s: absolute onset of first chorus/refrain/hook annotation
feature_semantics.first_chorus_annotated_timeline_ratio: first chorus onset divided by last annotated section start; NOT song-duration proportion
feature_semantics.aggregate_vocal_pitch_span_hz: max minus min across provider-reported vocal pitch statistics over all analyzed sections/performers; NOT single-melody range

deductive_decisions.claim: Earlier first chorus predicts stronger Year-End outcome
deductive_decisions.reason: No supported association in this contemporary collaboration cohort, including after year + collaboration-type/gender control.

deductive_decisions.claim: Larger aggregate vocal pitch span is associated with stronger Year-End outcome
deductive_decisions.reason: Small positive association survives year + collaboration-type/gender control but the measure aggregates multiple performers/sections and genre-style, exposure, artist history and other confounds remain.

boundary: This is an authorized contemporary calibration subpopulation, not the universal contemporary song population. Observed outcome is not equivalent to musical quality or causation.
